## Summary

**PMAXxW** (Vector maximum): Word-by-word vector compare and obtain biggest.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `4 x max ( a , b ) → d` |
| Syntax | `PMAXSW <vea>,b,d`<br>`PMAXUW <vea>,b,d` |
| Short | Word-by-word vector compare and obtain biggest. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–2 | `001101` |
| 2 | 1 | U |
| 2 | 0 | S |

- S=Size 0=byte, 1=word.
- U 1=unsigned , 0=signed

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PMAXxW. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
